messages:
sarah (Customer): Hey team — our private deployment started failing when we try to generate a debug bundle. Getting 500s from the collector service and the bundle never appears in the upload bucket. Request id: rwd-9f3b2c

alex (Support): sorry to hear that — can you paste the request id from the error response header and any short curl you used to trigger it? also which private node (region/hostname)?

sarah (Customer): request id above (rwd-9f3b2c). node: prod-vpc-3 (10.4.12.7). We ran the collector via the UI button and also tried the standalone script.

alex (Support): got it. a couple quick checks: 1) can you run a curl that reproduces the collector start and paste output? 2) check /var/log/collector/collector.log for the last 200 lines and paste errors (redact secrets)

sarah (Customer): here's a minimal curl we used:

```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Request-Id: rwd-9f3b2c" \
  https://internal-collector.prod.example.com/api/v1/start
```

Output shows 500 and header x-redwood-request-id: rwd-9f3b2c

alex (Support): thanks. can you copy the last 30 lines of /var/log/collector/collector.log (mask any IPs/keys)?

sarah (Customer): pasted lines: 

```
2026-03-09T14:18:52Z INFO starting collector v2.4.1
2026-03-09T14:18:55Z INFO gathering system info
2026-03-09T14:18:58Z WARN redaction: encountered non-text blob, skipping redaction for file /var/lib/app/model_weights.bin
2026-03-09T14:19:01Z ERROR upload: failed to create archive: open /tmp/collector-1798554321.tar.gz: permission denied
2026-03-09T14:19:01Z ERROR api: internal error, return 500
```

alex (Support): that permission denied is interesting — looks like the collector process couldn't write to /tmp. can you run `ls -ld /tmp` and `id` on the host and paste?

sarah (Customer): ls -ld /tmp -> "drwxr-x--- 3 root support 4096 Mar 9 13:00 /tmp". id -> "uid=1001(app) gid=110(support) groups=110(support)"

alex (Support): thanks. /tmp is not world-writable here which explains write failure when collector runs as the app user. Two options: run collector as root or change tmp dir. For immediate repro, please try collector with an explicit working-dir in your home: `--work-dir /home/app/tmp` and ensure that dir exists and writable.

nina (Eng): quick note on the redaction WARN — the collector tries to redact text artifacts, binary model weights will be skipped but that's OK. The redaction mismatch itself shouldn't cause 500s. The permission error will.

sarah (Customer): tried with `--work-dir /home/app/tmp` and the collector now produces an archive, but upload fails with 403 Forbidden. collector.log shows: 

```
2026-03-09T14:22:11Z INFO created archive /home/app/tmp/collector-1798554321.tar.gz
2026-03-09T14:22:12Z INFO upload: initiating upload to sftp://upload.redwood-internal.example.com:2222/bundles/prod-vpc-3/
2026-03-09T14:22:13Z ERROR upload: sftp: status 553 permission denied
2026-03-09T14:22:13Z ERROR api: internal error, return 500
```

alex (Support): 553 on SFTP is usually a server-side permission issue. @raj can you check SFTP account mapping for prod-vpc-3?

raj (SRE): looking. the upload service maps incoming SFTP key to a user folder prefix. I see recent ACL changes on the upload host — a migration script tightened permissions on /srv/upload/bundles/prod-vpc-3. I'll re-add the write bit for the mapping user. Give me 10m.

collector-bot: debug-bundle queued (id: dbg-1798554321) – awaiting upload confirmation

sarah (Customer): thanks — curious about redaction though. Any chance the archive contains PII and our compliance team needs to redact binaries differently? we saw the WARN about non-text blob earlier.

nina (Eng): binary files are skipped by design. If you need aggressive redaction we can run the redaction step server-side post-upload (it streams and strips text matches). But first get successful upload.

raj (SRE): update — fixed folder ACLs and restarted sftp. can you retry upload or re-run collector start?

sarah (Customer): re-ran with the same command. collector.log now: 

```
2026-03-09T14:31:02Z INFO upload: initiating upload to sftp://upload.redwood-internal.example.com:2222/bundles/prod-vpc-3/
2026-03-09T14:31:03Z INFO upload: transfer complete, remote path /srv/upload/bundles/prod-vpc-3/collector-1798554321.tar.gz
2026-03-09T14:31:04Z INFO api: upload confirmed, bundle id dbg-1798554321
```

collector-bot: debug-bundle received (id: dbg-1798554321) and scheduled for redaction

alex (Support): great — looks like root cause was /tmp perms plus SFTP ACLs. Action items: 1) we'll add a more informative collector error when /tmp isn't writable (ENG-3124) 2) SRE to review upload ACL migration steps (SRE-721) 3) Support to document `--work-dir` mitigation in KB (KB-1146)

nina (Eng): will pick up ENG-3124. quick follow up — can you confirm whether the customer used the UI-triggered collector (which runs as root via a privileged agent) or the app-initiated script? if it's UI-triggered we probably should not hit /tmp perms.

sarah (Customer): we used app-initiated script in deployment pipeline. UI-triggered would have worked. Thanks for the help everyone.

alex (Support): thanks — closing the loop here. if you want we can request the already-uploaded bundle to be processed with server-side redaction and share a download with compliance. Reply here and we'll coordinate. :thumbsup:

sarah (Customer): please do that, we need one redacted copy for compliance. happy to share the ticket.

collector-bot: redaction job started for dbg-1798554321

alex (Support): assigning to Nina for redaction follow-up. nina, i've put KB refs and logs in the internal ticket.

nina (Eng): got it — I'll run post-upload redaction and confirm when the redacted bundle is available (target: today EOD).

sarah (Customer): appreciated, thanks all :heart:
